diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default must wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin when creating a managed origin bucket. The supplied graph has no dependency path between them, so policy attachment can race bucket creation and fail with NoSuchBucket. Reference the managed bucket ID directly while preserving support for an existing origin.

:resource.aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.origin configures :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin and must run after that bucket exists. The supplied graph expresses no such ordering, allowing public-access-block configuration to race bucket creation. Its count already limits it to managed origin buckets, so use the bucket resource's ID directly.

:data.aws_s3_bucket.selected must wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin when looking up a newly managed origin bucket. The supplied graph only orders this lookup after the static bucket variable, so it can read the origin before creation and fail. Reference the managed bucket ID while retaining the existing-origin and static-bucket fallback cases.
